title: Pampanga Marathon 2026 Review: A Established Clark Parade Grounds Fixture
meta_description: Pampanga Marathon 2026 review: September 13 at Clark Parade Grounds -- a race run annually since at least 2022, with RFID bibs and rainy-season timing.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at CDC Clark Parade Grounds, this is at least the fifth annual running of the Pampanga Marathon under organiser SMOKE10 Events -- four distances, RFID timing, and a race date that falls squarely in the Philippine typhoon season.
verdict: The Pampanga Marathon has genuine continuity behind it -- run annually at Clark Parade Grounds since at least 2022, with editions in 2023, 2024 and 2025 under the same SMOKE10 Events organiser. Four core distances (5K to 42K, with some editions adding a 16K) and a full race-kit package (RFID bib, singlet, medal, finisher shirt) suggest a well-established, repeatable operation rather than a first-year unknown. The real variable is weather: race day falls in September, squarely within the Philippine rainy and typhoon season, so runners should plan for possible wet conditions regardless of how smoothly the event itself is run.

sections.heading: A Repeat Fixture, Not a Debut
paragraphs: The event is organized by SMOKE10 Events Management and has run annually at Clark Parade Grounds (CDC) in the Clark Freeport Zone since at least 2022, with prior editions in 2023, 2024 and 2025 under the same organizer. Clark Parade Grounds itself is a historic open space within the former Clark Air Base complex, now part of the redeveloped Freeport Zone. [1] That multi-year continuity is a meaningful point in this race's favour compared to several first-year debut events in this same research batch.

sections.heading: Four Distances, Early Start
paragraphs: Distances offered are 5K, 10K, 21K and 42K (some editions have also included a 16K), catering to both casual and serious runners. [2] The 2026 edition lists an early gun start around 4:30-4:45am, typical for Philippine road races managing daytime heat.

sections.heading: A Full Race Kit
paragraphs: Race kit for the 2026 edition includes a race bib with RFID, singlet, medal, finisher shirt and drawstring bag, based on the official registration listing. [2] That's a reasonably complete package for a regional race, and the RFID timing suggests a level of technical investment beyond a purely casual community fun run.

sections.heading: September Means Typhoon Season
paragraphs: The race takes place in September, within the Philippine rainy/typhoon season, so runners should be prepared for possible wet weather based on historical patterns in Clark/Pampanga races held in this period. That's true of essentially any Philippine race scheduled in this window, but worth factoring into gear choices and expectations regardless of how well-organised the event itself is.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a well-established, repeat-year race in the Clark Freeport Zone with a full kit and RFID timing, the Pampanga Marathon on 13 September 2026 is a reliable pick backed by real continuity. Just pack for possible rain, given the September date sits inside typhoon season.
